sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: What I believe the market narrative is: ACES permanently impaired its moat by losing the ACE Hardware licence to MAP and faces structural margin compression amid weak Indonesian discretionary spending.

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown:
- **Accruals & cash conversion (3y):** Clean — accruals ratio `(NI - CFO) / avg_assets` ran **-7.1%** (FY23), **+1.1%** (FY24), **-11.7%** (FY25), with CFO/NI conversion of **170%**, **90%**, and **246%** (`data/dossiers/ACES.fund record`). Receivables/payables are small relative to inventory (`IDR 3.4tn` in FY24; `coverage/companies/ACES.JK/assumptions.yaml`); no channel-stuffing signature.
- **IDX status:** Main Board, liquid/dividend and KEHATI ESG index constituent (`S13`); no special-monitoring notation observed. 9M2026 (`S2`) is unaudited.
- **Optics-class / unverified-footnote flags (no confirmed manipulation-class flag):**
  1. **Unidentified `other_nonop`:** Pre-tax profit exceeded `EBIT + net interest` by `IDR 186bn` (FY25) and `IDR 267.5bn` (9M26), positive in all five quarters (`43.3, 41.5, 58.5, 156.0, 52.9bn`; `fund record`). Stripping `other_nonop` drops operating dividend cover below 1.0x at an 80% payout.
  2. **PSAK 73 lease-flow gap:** Historical cash reconciliation (`FCF - Div - dCash`) shows `IDR 447-514bn/yr` of lease principal outflows in financing cash flows (`FY23: 513.8bn, FY24: 473.5bn, FY25: 447.2bn`). Unadjusted FCFF adding back ROU D&A (`~4.3-4.5%` rev) without ROU renewals overstates owner earnings; ROU and RPT footnotes (Kawan Lama leases/services) remain unverified because `idx.co.id`/IR site were unreachable (`fund record` §3, §6).

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
- **Operating path (most likely):** 9M2026 delivered `IDR 6,857.2bn` sales (+8.3% YoY, SSSG +2.4% vs BI retail index +0.6%; `fund record` F2, F12, F20), `IDR 496.8bn` EBIT (7.24%; Q3 jumped to 9.58%), and `IDR 604.7bn` NI (+25.7% YoY; F18). Adding a normal Q4 (`~IDR 2,447bn` sales, +6.2% YoY) yields **FY2026E revenue `IDR 9,303.9bn`** (+7.7% YoY) and **EBIT `IDR 707.1bn`** (7.6% margin). With 282 AZKO and 31 NEKA stores at 9M26 (F1, F4) plus ~5-11 delayed AZKO openings rolling into FY27, revenue grows **+7.0% (FY27E)** and **+6.0% (FY28E)**, fading to **4.0% terminal** (`<8.6%` nominal GDP). Gross margin holds **~47.6-47.8%** (weak IDR ~18,080-18,350 and NEKA mix cap recovery to FY24's 48.7%), while post-rebrand efficiency lifts EBIT margin modestly to **7.8% (FY27E)** and **8.0-8.1% (FY28E-30E)**. `other_nonop` normalizes from `IDR 312bn` (FY26E, incl. Q2 spike) to the 4-quiet-quarter run-rate (`IDR 196bn` FY27E, `198bn` FY28E), taxed at 18.5%; payout holds 80% on net cash (`~IDR 2,059bn` end-FY26E post-FY25 dividend).
- **Owner-earnings & DCF (VAL_COMPOUNDER_QUALITY):** To avoid PSAK 73 distortion, we value retail operations on **pre-PSAK-73 owner earnings**: `EBIT_adj = EBIT - 0.9% rev` lease interest, adding only pure PPE D&A (`2.3%` rev) less cash capex (`2.5%` FY26E; `3.0%` FY27E+) less NWC drag (`38.3%` of incremental sales — 2y Dec average). FY27E reinvestment rate is **57.0%** at **16.2% ROIIC** (steady-state ~14-15% ROIIC). Discounting 10y FCFFs (fade to year 10 on 90-city distribution density moat; `WACC = 12.0%` midpoint of IDR 11-13% band; `g = 4.0%`) gives **Retail EV `IDR 4,461bn`** (exit **6.6x EV/EBIT_adj**, passing multiple survival). Adding end-FY26E cash (`IDR 2,059bn`; lease debt excluded to avoid double-counting full rent) and capitalized `other_nonop` (`IDR 1,331bn` at 12%) yields **Base `IDR 459/sh`** (Bear `IDR 243`, Bull `IDR 634`).
- **Sensitivity (Base Rp/sh):** WACC `11%/12%/13%` → `505 / 459 / 422`; EBIT margin `-1.5pp/0/+1.5pp` → `366 / 459 / 551`; `other_nonop` `0 / 196bn` → `381 / 459`.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **Store rollout slippage & cannibalization:** AZKO added only 5 stores in Q3 (19 YTD vs 25-30 target; `fund record` F8, F21), and FY25's 27 AZKO openings yielded just +0.7% revenue growth (`data/dossiers/ACES.fund record`), showing tier-2/3 cannibalization.
2. **Returning ACE Hardware competition & weak macro:** MAP opened ACE Hardware in Sunter Mall (Jul-2026) and Serpong (`fund record` §1) just as BI retail sales slowed to +0.6% YoY (`F12`) under `balance_of_payments_pressure` (`the macro regime memo`).
3. **Unexplained `other_nonop` & thin operating dividend cover:** `IDR 186bn` (FY25) and `IDR 267.5bn` (9M26) below-the-line income is unidentified; ex-`other_nonop`, FY26E retail NOPAT (`~IDR 577bn`) barely covers or falls short of the `IDR 548-648bn` cash dividend (`F14`, `fund record` §3).
4. **Unverified PSAK 73 lease & Kawan Lama RPT footnotes:** Full LK footnotes remain inaccessible (`fund record` §3, §6); undisclosed off-debt leases or adverse group-lease resets directly reduce equity value (`~Rp 58/sh` per `IDR 1tn`).

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** At `Rp 352` (`-22.1%` 12m, ~7.4x FY26E P/E, ~0.9x P/B), ACES is structurally impaired post-ACE licence loss, with MAP's re-entry eroding share amid soft discretionary demand.
**Why wrong:** FY25 absorbed the margin reset (7.2% EBIT margin vs 11.9% FY24), yet 9M26 sales grew +8.3% YoY with +2.4% SSSG (`F2`, `F20`) vs BI retail +0.6% (`F12`), showing AZKO's 282-store, 90-city network held customers. At `Rp 340-352` (~6.6x EV/EBIT_adj, ~8.8% net yield), reaching `Rp 459` needs zero multiple expansion.
**What proves us wrong:** Two consecutive negative-SSSG quarters as MAP expands, gross margin `<46.5%`, `other_nonop` disappearing forcing a dividend cut (`<Rp 25`), or hidden ROU/RPT leaks.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is Nov 2029 and this position lost 30-45%. MAP's ACE Hardware captured flagship branded-tool suppliers and Jabodetabek footfall while weak IDR (`>18,350`) compressed gross margin below 46%. Without `other_nonop` and facing adverse Kawan Lama lease resets, payout fell below 60%, sending shares to Bear `Rp 244`. An IDX ARB-gap (-25% band) below `Rp 244` fills near **`Rp 184`** (`-45.9%` from `Rp 340`).

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Fact-check & cash defect (`fund record`, `fund record`):** 9M26 sales `Rp 6,857.2bn`, EBIT `496.8bn`, NI `604.7bn`, `other_nonop` `267.5bn` (Q2 spike `156.0bn`), and CFF lease outflows `447-514bn/yr` verify. However, `Rp 2,059bn` end-FY26E cash "ex-lease debt" fails `2026Q3` actuals: cash fell `-41%` YTD to `1,404.4bn` vs `939.6bn` debt (net cash **`Rp 464.8bn`**), and debt includes WC facilities (`fund record`). Hitting `2,059bn` needs an unsourced `+655bn` Q4 cash surge post-leases. `[MATERIAL]`
2. **Single-assumption dependency (`fund record` §3):** Capitalizing unidentified `other_nonop` (`Rp 1,331bn` at 12%) supplies **29.8% of Retail EV (`4,461bn`)** and `Rp 77.7/sh`, contradicting `fund record` L374-377 barring capitalization alongside cash (double-count). Stripping it cuts Base to `Rp 381/sh` (`+12.1%`), drops `FY26E` operating dividend cover to **`0.89x`** (`577bn` NOPAT vs `648bn` div), lowers `net_div_yield_pct_pa` (post-10% WHT) from `8.8%` to `~6.6%` (`Rp 22.6/sh`), and turns **`EV = -5.2%`** (Quarter-Kelly `0`). `[FATAL]`
3. **NWC surge, PSAK 73 & ARB gap (`fund record`, `the fund rules`):** `3Q26` inventory jumped `+33%` in two quarters (`2,938bn -> 3,905bn`), lifting NWC to **`43.9%` of FY26E sales** (`4,081bn`) vs `38.3%` modeled. On `30-Sep` net cash (`465bn`) ex-`other_nonop`, equity drops to `~Rp 288/sh` before unverified Kawan Lama lease/RPT gaps (`~Rp 58/sh` per `1tn`). An IDX `-25%` ARB lock below `kill 244` fills near **`Rp 184`** (`-45.9%`), cutting EV to **`-4.0%`**. `[FATAL]`
4. **Omitted news & competition (`fund record`, `S9`):** On `2026-11-18` Kontan reported ACES raised its 2026 AZKO target to **40-45 stores** (vs 25-30; 19 opened 9M26), refuting "5-11 delayed openings" and signaling Q4 capex/lease strain. MAP reopened ACE Hardware in Jakarta/Serpong (`S9`) after FY25 EBIT margin fell `-470bp` (`11.9% -> 7.2%`) and 27 openings added `+0.7%` sales. `[MATERIAL]`
5. **Archetype/macro mismatch (`the base-rate library`, `the macro regime memo`):** Screened `MOMENTUM #9` (`mom12 -22.1%`, `flow_stale: True`); `derated_compounder_rerating` (`p_up 0.40`, `n=15`) warns against structural share loss. Fights `consumer discretionary AVOID` (`IDR 18,225`) and duplicates live `ERAA.JK` (`CONSUMER / domestic_cycle`). `[MATERIAL]`
6. **Pre-mortem:** Audited FY26 LK reveals Kawan Lama leases and `other_nonop` vanishes; dividend cuts `<Rp 22/sh`, gapping ARB past `244`. `[MINOR]`
7. **Anti-gaming & anomalies:** `stage_log`/`estimates_committed_at` clean. Verbatim anomalies: `the calibration report report` returns `{"n": 0}`; `the price snapshot` (55) and `the liquidity feed` (52) omit `ACES.JK`; `fund record` is empty (`flow_stale: True`). `[MINOR]`

**Stop-objecting price:** `Rp 255/sh` (with audited LK ROU/RPT footnotes and `other_nonop` disclosure).
**Verdict:** `KILL_RECOMMENDED` — **Strongest sentence:** Capitalizing an unidentified plug for 30% of Retail EV and an unsourced `+655bn` Q4 cash surge still yields negative EV (`-4.0%` ARB-gap, `-5.2%` ex-`other_nonop`) against an `AVOID` macro regime and a returning licensor.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
1. **Q3 cash/NWC:** `fund record` shows `2026Q1->Q3` NWC jumped `+1,195bn` (`2,886->4,081bn`) while cash fell `2,717->1,404bn` after `548bn` dividends; seasonal Q4 unwind explains most of `~2,020bn` year-end cash, **except** debt (`940bn`) includes unquantified WC facilities (`fund record`). Concede cash-bridge uncertainty until FY26 LK.
2. **`other_nonop` FATAL (cut bought by Bear #2):** Concede. `fund record` L374-377 bars capitalizing unidentified `other_nonop` (`1,331bn`). Stripping it cuts `exit_plan.target` `459 -> 381` (`up_pct: 35.0 -> 12.1%`, `>20%` move), trims `net_div_yield_pct_pa` `8.8 -> 6.6%` (`>20%` move; `0.89x` FY26E operating cover), and flips `expected_pct` `+6.6 -> -5.1%` (`>20%` move; `up/|down| = 1.06`, Quarter-Kelly `0%`).
3. **NWC/PSAK 73/ARB gap FATAL:** Holding `30-Sep` cash (`1,404bn`) + `43.9%` NWC cuts stripped Base further to `Rp 324/sh` (`Rp 269/sh` if `940bn` debt deducted). Under `-25%` ARB gap (`Rp 184`, `-45.9%`), `Rp 340` EV is `-15.7%` (and `-8.1%` even at `Rp 312`, the lowest stageable price within 10% of `352`). A forced `Rp 254` entry sits unstageable (`-28%` below spot) just `Rp 10` above Bear `244`. **Per `SIZING §3(c)`, no coherent trade exists in the traded range; concede `KILL_RECOMMENDED`.**
4. **Kontan 40-45 stores & MAP:** Concede; aggressive Q4 openings tighten Q4 cash/lease burn while MAP targets branded tools.
5. **Archetype/macro:** Concede; against `consumer discretionary AVOID` (`IDR 18,225`) and `ERAA.JK` overlap, negative EV cannot pass.
6. **Pre-mortem:** Accepted; unverified ROU/RPT/`other_nonop` breaks dividend cover.
7. **Anomalies:** Noted (`the price snapshot`/`the liquidity feed` omit `ACES.JK`; `fund record` empty). Revisit only post-cooldown (` 381` (`up_pct: 35.0 -> 12.1%`), `net_div_yield_pct_pa` `8.8 -> 6.6%`, and `expected_pct` `+6.6 -> -5.1%` (`up/|down| = 1.06`, `Quarter-Kelly = 0%`). Both `[FATAL]` defects remain dispositive: (1) ex-`other_nonop`, operating dividend cover is `0.89x` (`FY26E`) and expected return is negative even before `3Q26` NWC (`43.9%`) or unverified Kawan Lama lease/debt deductions (`Rp 269–324/sh` stripped value); (2) under IDX `-25%` ARB (`Rp 184`), EV drops to `-15.7%` at `Rp 340` (`-8.1%` at `Rp 312`). Analyst concedes `KILL_RECOMMENDED`.

**Re-attack verdict:** `KILL_RECOMMENDED` — uninvestable in the stageable range; revisit only post-cooldown (`<=Rp 255/sh`) with audited FY26 LK ROU/RPT footnotes and `other_nonop` breakdown.
